name: dial-indicator
description: A contact dial indicator with a pointer and exposed measuring plunger.
useCase: Show a dial indicator for precision displacement measurements.
misuse: Use gauge for a general measurement display.

16.reason: A compact dial leaves a long contact plunger exposed below its collar; the solid pointer stays clear of the rim.

24.reason: The round dial and lower collar frame an exposed measuring plunger; the solid pointer stays clear of the dial rim.
